description:
This 2021 Lamborghini Urus Pearl Capsule pairs the world s first Super Sport Utility Vehicle with one of Lamborghini s most distinctive factory styling packages. It is finished in brilliant white with high-gloss black accents. The contrast package runs from the front splitter to the side sills and rear diffuser, and continues to the gloss black mirror caps and window surrounds. The car rides on 23-inch Taigete wheels in shiny black, with red-painted calipers behind them over cross-drilled carbon-ceramic rotors. The combination gives the Urus a sharp, purposeful presence from every angle.

Power comes from Lamborghini s 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, producing 641 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. It is paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time all-wheel drive. The Urus reaches 62 mph in 3.6 seconds and has a top speed of 190 mph, numbers that place it among the fastest production SUVs ever built. An electro-mechanical limited-slip differential, front and rear active anti-roll bars, and an adaptive, height-adjustable air suspension let the Urus move from relaxed daily driving to track-focused handling at the turn of a selector.

The interior is finished in black leather with red contrast stitching throughout. The front and rear seats carry the Pearl Capsule s signature hexagonal quilted stitching in red, and red Lamborghini shields are embroidered into every headrest. Alcantara covers the headliner and pillars. Brushed dark trim, silver accents, and a Lamborghini script across the passenger-side dash complete the design. The aircraft-inspired center console houses the red flip-cover start button and the ANIMA drive mode selector with Strada, Sport, Corsa, Sabbia, Terra, and Neve modes, plus the customizable EGO mode.

The Urus combines true supercar performance with four-door, five-passenger everyday usability. It is a high-performance SUV that drives like a Lamborghini and works like a luxury daily driver.

This 2021 Lamborghini Urus is finished in Bianco Monocerus over a Rosso Alala and Nero Ade interior, one of the boldest color pairings offered on Lamborghini s super SUV. Gloss black accents frame the white body, including the wheel arches, lower sills, mirror caps, roof rails, front intakes, and rear diffuser. Gloss black multi-spoke wheels with gold Lamborghini center caps sit in front of red brake calipers with Lamborghini script, giving it an aggressive look from every angle.

Power comes from a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 producing 641 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. It is paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time all-wheel drive. The Urus reaches 60 mph in about 3.6 seconds and has a top speed of 190 mph, performance that put it among the fastest production SUVs of its time. Hexagon-quilted, perforated leather runs through the front and rear seats, and every headrest carries an embroidered red Lamborghini shield. Rosso Alala leather continues across the door panels, center armrest, and passenger-side dash, which carries Lamborghini script. Contrast red stitching runs throughout. GLACIER WHITE METALLIC This RS Q8 has the following features: Convenience
  • Remote parking - Fit in anywhere! Remote parking system allows you to pull into or out of a space without having to be in the vehicle, simply use the remote control! It's perfect when the cars next to you are too close for you to be able open your doors. With remote parking, any spot is an open spot!
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Audi smartphone interface w/wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring

The 2026 Mercedes-Maybach GLS 600 4MATIC is the flagship of the Mercedes-Benz SUV lineup and the most refined expression of the GLS platform. This GLS 600 is finished in a matte gray exterior paired with a MANUFAKTUR Crystal White and Silver Grey Pearl Exclusive Nappa leather interior. The combination is understated outside and bright and open inside. Polished 23-inch Maybach monoblock wheels, a vertical chrome Maybach grille, chrome lower fascia accents, and Maybach pattern front intakes complete a presence that is unmistakably Maybach.

Power comes from a handcrafted 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 with a 48-volt mild-hybrid system and integrated starter generator. It produces 550 horsepower and 538 lb-ft of torque. Power is delivered through the 9G-TRONIC 9-speed automatic transmission to a full-time 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system. Despite its size and level of luxury, the GLS 600 reaches 60 mph in 4.8 seconds. The mild-hybrid system smooths engine start-stop operation, supports low-speed efficiency, and adds a seamless boost of torque under acceleration.

Ride quality defines the Maybach experience. The GLS 600 uses a predictive adaptive air suspension with driver-adjustable ride height and automatic leveling. It is paired with E-ACTIVE BODY CONTROL, which actively manages body roll front and rear. The system reads the road ahead and prepares the suspension in advance, so the vehicle stays composed and remarkably quiet at any speed.

The interior is configured for four passengers, with two executive rear seats separated by a full-length rear center console. Rear occupants have reclining seats with extendable calf rests, plush Maybach headrest pillows, matching lumbar pillows, and dedicated touchscreen controllers. The MBUX High-End Rear Seat Entertainment System adds a screen behind each front seat. Diamond-quilted perforated Nappa leather with contrasting piping covers the seats, and Nappa leather extends to the dashboard, door panels, and headliner. MANUFAKTUR High-Gloss Black Piano Lacquer trim adds contrast throughout. A two-row panoramic glass sunroof fills the interior with natural light, and a Burmester High-End 3D Surround Sound System delivers concert-level audio throughout.

If you're searching for a 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 for sale in Warren, Michigan, your search ends here. Empire Auto Collection, located in Warren in Macomb County, has just taken in one of the most iconic and capable luxury SUVs ever built — and with under 2,000 miles on the odometer, this is essentially a brand-new AMG G 63 at a fraction of the wait. Grey exterior, a thunderous twin-turbo V8, and full AMG Sport Utility presence make this one of the most compelling vehicles available in southeast Michigan right now.About This 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 Sport UtilityWith only 1,978 miles, this 2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 is as close to factory-fresh as it gets on the pre-owned market. The grey exterior gives it a refined, stealthy look that stands apart from the more common white and black builds you see on the road. As a 2027 model year, this G 63 represents the latest iteration of Mercedes-AMG's engineering and refinement cycle, meaning you're getting the most current technology, safety systems, and interior appointments available in this generation. Whether you're buying for the prestige, the performance, or the unmatched road presence, this SUV delivers on every level.2027 Mercedes-AMG G 63 Performance and Engine

Twin-Turbo V8 Power

Under the hood sits a handcrafted 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine — AMG's legendary hot inside V8 configuration — producing 577 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque in standard G 63 trim. This engine propels the G 63 from zero to sixty in around four seconds, a number that seems impossible for a vehicle built on a body-on-frame platform that dates back to the 1970s. The power delivery is immediate, authoritative, and addictive.

AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT 9-Speed Transmission

Paired to that V8 is AMG's 9G-TRONIC nine-speed automatic transmission with SPEEDSHIFT TCT technology. This unit offers lightning-fast gear changes in Sport and Sport+ modes, seamless cruising comfort in Normal mode, and full manual control via the AMG steering wheel paddles. The result is a drivetrain that feels equally at home on a Monday morning commute and a weekend canyon run.

AWD and AMG-Tuned Dynamics

All-wheel drive comes standard, and in the G 63 it's paired with three locking differentials — a carry-over from the G-Wagen's military roots that makes this the most off-road capable AMG vehicle in the lineup. Combined with AMG-tuned air suspension and electronically controlled dampers, the ride quality is far more composed on pavement than the boxy exterior suggests.Mercedes-AMG G 63 Features and Interior

AMG Sport Utility Appointments

The G 63 Sport Utility trim brings a level of interior luxury that rivals anything in the Mercedes-Benz S-Class lineup. Expect AMG-exclusive Nappa leather upholstery, a redesigned widescreen MBUX cockpit display, AMG Performance steering wheel with touch-sensitive controls, ambient lighting with dozens of color options, and the signature round dashboard vents finished in chrome. The Comfort and Wellbeing Pack further elevates the sensory atmosphere, ensuring every journey is exceptionally relaxing for all seven occupants.

Advanced driver-focused technology seamlessly integrates into the driving experience. A high-resolution Head-Up Display projects critical speed and navigation guidance directly into your field of view, allowing you to stay focused on the road ahead. Audio entertainment is provided by the immersive Meridian Three-Dimensional Surround Sound System, delivering crisp, rich acoustics throughout the expansive interior.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. This 2023 Lamborghini Urus Performante is the most focused, track-capable version of Lamborghini s Super SUV, and this car takes that character even further. It wears a satin bronze wrap and a full 1016 Industries widebody kit. The kit adds carbon fiber fender flares, a reshaped front bumper with carbon fiber splitter elements, a vented hood, carbon fiber side skirts, a roof-mounted rear spoiler and an aggressive carbon fiber rear diffuser. Black multi-spoke wheels with Lamborghini center caps complete a look that is wider, lower and far more dramatic than any standard Urus.

Power comes from Lamborghini s 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, tuned in Performante form to produce 657 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. It is paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time all-wheel drive with an electro-mechanical limited-slip differential. The Urus Performante accelerates from 0 to 62 mph in 3.3 seconds and reaches a top speed of 190 mph. Lamborghini also made the Performante lighter than the standard Urus. In place of the standard car s air suspension, it uses a sport-tuned chassis with coil springs, adaptive magnetic dampers and active anti-roll bars, giving it a sharper, more connected feel on the road and on track.

The interior matches the exterior s intensity. It is trimmed in black Alcantara and leather with yellow contrast stitching throughout. The seats feature hexagonal quilting, embroidered URUS lettering, Lamborghini shield headrests and Performante script on the bolsters. Bright yellow seatbelts, an Alcantara headliner with hexagonal stitching, carbon fiber dashboard and console trim, and an Alcantara steering wheel with a red top-center marker give the interior a purpose-built motorsport atmosphere.

Few vehicles combine everyday usability with this level of performance and visual impact. With seating for five, a usable cargo area and all-weather all-wheel drive, this Urus Performante works as a daily driver. Celebrating Bentley's legendary W12 engine, the Bentayga Speed Edition 12 represents an extraordinary combination of handcrafted British luxury, breathtaking performance, and exceptional collector appeal. Exclusive Bentayga Speed Edition 12: A special limited-edition model created to celebrate Bentley's iconic W12 engine, representing a significant chapter in the marque's extraordinary history of luxury performance and automotive craftsmanship.

6.0-Liter Twin-Turbocharged W12 Engine: Produces an exhilarating 626 horsepower and 664 lb-ft of torque, delivering breathtaking acceleration, effortless power, and the unmistakable refinement of Bentley's legendary twelve-cylinder powertrain.

Limited-Production Edition 12 Heritage: Part of an exclusive production series commemorating the final chapter of Bentley's W12 engine, offering exceptional exclusivity and appeal among enthusiasts and collectors.

Beluga Exterior: A timeless and sophisticated Bentley finish that beautifully complements the Bentayga Speed's commanding proportions, sculpted bodywork, and unmistakable luxury presence.

Beluga Interior: A beautifully appointed monochromatic cabin featuring premium Bentley craftsmanship, luxurious materials, and an elegant, performance-inspired atmosphere.

Bentayga Styling Specification: Factory-selected exterior styling enhancements designed to emphasize the Bentayga Speed's aggressive proportions and distinctive sporting character.

Touring Specification: A comprehensive collection of advanced driver-assistance technologies designed to enhance comfort, confidence, and convenience during extended journeys.

Edition 12 Exclusive Design Details: Special Edition 12 styling elements celebrate Bentley's legendary twelve-cylinder heritage and distinguish this exceptional model from conventional Bentayga configurations.

All-Wheel-Drive Performance: Bentley's advanced permanent all-wheel-drive system provides outstanding traction, stability, and confidence across varying driving conditions.

8-Speed Automatic Transmission: Sophisticated transmission technology delivers smooth, responsive gear changes and effortless performance worthy of Bentley's flagship luxury SUV.

Adaptive Air Suspension: Advanced electronically controlled air suspension delivers exceptional ride comfort, composed handling, and outstanding grand touring refinement.

Deep Pile Overmats: Luxurious factory-selected floor coverings further elevate the cabin's handcrafted atmosphere and premium comfort.

Handcrafted Bentley Interior: Beautifully finished leather upholstery, refined interior materials, and meticulous attention to detail showcase Bentley's longstanding tradition of exceptional British craftsmanship.

W12 Collector Appeal: As a special edition celebrating one of Bentley's most celebrated engines, the Bentayga Speed Edition 12 represents a compelling opportunity to own a distinctive piece of the marque's performance heritage.

description: EXCLUSIVE, TWIN-TURBO V8-POWERED, SEVEN-PASSENGER, BARELY DRIVEN, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, MANUFAKTUR LUXURY THAT TURNS EVERY HEAD! The 2025 Mercedes-Benz GLS 580 4MATIC is the flagship full-size luxury SUV, and this one is a showstopper in MANUFAKTUR Signature Ireland Mid Green Metallic, a bespoke hand-selected finish that sets it apart from the sea of black, white and silver in every parking lot. Inside, Catalana Beige and Black leather pairs with MANUFAKTUR Piano Lacquer Flowing Lines trim, while the 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 with EQ Boost, 510 horsepower and a 9-speed automatic send power through 4MATIC all-wheel drive, with the odometer hovering around 3,800 miles. CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, and the Pinnacle Trim adds a head-up display, active multicontour power front seats with massage and the MBUX Interior Assistant, so every drive feels like a first-class experience. With seating for seven, a panoramic power moonroof and a 13-speaker Burmester sound system, this GLS is ready for the school run, the airport and the long weekend away. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The GLS is Mercedes-Benz's largest and most luxurious SUV, often called the S-Class of SUVs, and it is built for families who want first-class comfort for up to seven. Cross-shopped against the BMW X7, Cadillac Escalade, Range Rover and Lincoln Navigator, it stands apart with a hushed, tech-rich cabin, genuine third-row room, an adaptive, auto-leveling ride and the effortless power of the GLS 580's twin-turbo V8. Just as important is how easy it is to live with. The reclining third row folds away for up to roughly 85 cubic feet of cargo space, the 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system keeps it confident in rain and snow, and a towing rating of up to 7,700 pounds means it can handle the boat or camper as well as the carpool. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Kelley Blue Book gives the 2025 Mercedes-Benz GLS 580 an expert rating of 4.2 out of 5, praising its upscale cabin, powerful engine lineup and surprising off-road ability. WARRANTY The odometer currently reads 3,803 miles. This GLS was reacquired by the manufacturer, and its remaining Mercedes-Benz factory coverage could not be independently confirmed, so no remaining factory warranty is promised here and any such provisions have been omitted. We recommend confirming current coverage by VIN with an authorized Mercedes-Benz dealer. It has averaged roughly 2,400 miles per year since an estimated in-service date of March 2025, far below the 15,000-mile industry average, so this GLS has plenty of life left to enjoy. Extended service plans may be available for buyers who want added peace of mind. STANDARD FEATURES The GLS 580 is the V8 flagship of the lineup, pairing a 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 with a 48-volt EQ Boost mild-hybrid system, a 9-speed automatic and 4MATIC all-wheel drive. Adaptive, auto-leveling suspension, leather upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, dual-zone front and rear climate control and a panoramic power moonroof make it as comfortable as it is quick. Technology and safety are just as generous. Dual 12.3-inch displays running the MBUX system, MB Navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, a front wireless charging pad and a Burmester sound system keep the cabin connected, while Active Brake Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, DISTRONIC adaptive cruise control and a Surround View Monitor help watch the road with you. INSTALLED OPTIONS MANUFAKTUR Signature Ireland Mid Green Metallic Paint MANUFAKTUR Signature Ireland Mid Green Metallic exterior finish. A rare, deep green metallic from Mercedes-Benz's bespoke program that stands out from the usual palette and shows off the GLS's lines in changing light. Pinnacle Trim Head-up display. Projects speed and key driving information onto the windshield so your eyes stay on the road. Active multicontour power front seats with massage. Adjust to support you on long drives, with a massage function for added comfort. Rapid heating front seats. Warm up faster on cold New Jersey mornings. MBUX Interior Assistant. Responds to gestures and helps you control cabin functions with a simple movement. Air Balance. Helps freshen and filter the cabin air for a more pleasant ride. Temperature-controlled cupholders. Keep drinks warm or cool on the go. Mercedes Star pattern logo projectors. Light up the ground beside the doors with the Mercedes star as you get in and out. Standalone Features MANUFAKTUR Piano Lacquer Flowing Lines trim. A glossy, hand-finished interior trim with flowing lines that gives the cabin a bespoke, upscale look. MECHANICAL FEATURES The 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 produces 510 horsepower at 5,500 rpm and 538 lb-ft of torque from just 2,000 rpm, so the GLS 580 moves with smooth, effortless authority at any speed. The EQ Boost mild-hybrid system adds a 21-horsepower electric motor for extra response, and the 9-speed automatic keeps shifts seamless around town and relaxed on the highway. 4MATIC all-wheel drive helps the GLS stay planted in rain, snow and on loose surfaces, while the adaptive, auto-leveling suspension smooths out rough pavement and keeps the ride composed under a full load of passengers and luggage. 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 with 510 horsepower and 538 lb-ft of torque. EQ Boost 48-volt mild-hybrid system with a 21-horsepower electric motor. 9-speed automatic transmission. 4MATIC all-wheel drive. Adaptive, auto-leveling suspension. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars. Speed-sensitive power steering. Estimated fuel economy: 14 mpg city, 19 mpg highway and 16 mpg combined (premium fuel recommended). Estimated maximum towing capacity: up to 7,700 pounds with the proper equipment. EXTERIOR FEATURES MANUFAKTUR Signature Ireland Mid Green Metallic gives this GLS a rare and unmistakable presence, and the panoramic power moonroof lets the sky in. A power liftgate makes loading easy, and the long 123.4-inch wheelbase gives the big SUV a planted, confident stance. MANUFAKTUR Signature Ireland Mid Green Metallic paint. Panoramic power moonroof. Power liftgate. Estimated overall length: about 205.2 inches. Estimated wheelbase: about 123.4 inches. Estimated overall width: about 79.9 inches, not including mirrors. Estimated overall height: about 71.8 inches. INTERIOR FEATURES Step inside and the GLS 580 delivers first-class comfort for up to seven. Catalana Beige and Black leather, MANUFAKTUR Piano Lacquer Flowing Lines trim and a leather-wrapped steering wheel set a warm, upscale tone, while heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats and dual-zone front and rear climate control keep every passenger comfortable. The Pinnacle Trim's active multicontour front seats with massage, rapid seat heating and temperature-controlled cupholders turn the front row into a lounge, and the reclining third row gives rear passengers real room to relax. Seating for seven with a split-bench second row and a reclining third row. Catalana Beige and Black leather upholstery. Leather-wrapped steering wheel. MANUFAKTUR Piano Lacquer Flowing Lines trim. Heated and ventilated front seats. Active multicontour power front seats with massage. Rapid heating front seats. Heated rear seats. Power front seats with memory for the driver. Dual-zone front and rear climate control. Panoramic power moonroof. Temperature-controlled cupholders. Estimated cargo volume: about 17 cubic feet behind the third row and about 85 cubic feet with the rear seats folded. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY Two 12.3-inch displays running Mercedes-Benz's MBUX system anchor the dash, bringing navigation, voice control, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto together in one sleek, high-resolution panel. The Burmester sound system fills the cabin with detailed, immersive audio, and the head-up display keeps key information right in your line of sight. Dual 12.3-inch displays with the MBUX system. MB Navigation with voice control. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Front wireless phone charging. Bluetooth. 13-speaker Burmester sound system. Head-up display. MBUX Interior Assistant. Surround View Monitor. SiriusXM satellite radio capability. Subscription may be required to maintain service. SAFETY FEATURES The GLS is built around Mercedes-Benz's reputation for safety, with a full suite of airbags and a long list of driver-assistance technologies that help you stay aware and in control in busy traffic and on long highway drives. Active Brake Assist with pedestrian detection. PRE-SAFE PLUS rear collision mitigation. Active Blind Spot Assist. Active Lane Keeping Assist. Active Parking Assist. Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC adaptive cruise control. Surround View Monitor. Front, front side, overhead curtain (all three rows), driver knee and occupant-sensing airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control and four-wheel antilock disc brakes. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! Please note that around October 2025, Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC reacquired this GLS from its first owner after a transmission function concern was reported. Although details of the repairs weren't provided, consumer protection laws generally require buyback defects to be corrected and disclosed before resale. Around the same time, service records also show replacement of the transmission and valve body. Manufacturer documentation is available and will be reviewed with the purchaser. THE BOTTOM LINE With a 510-horsepower twin-turbo V8, seating for seven, a rare MANUFAKTUR green finish, the Pinnacle Trim's massaging seats and head-up display, no accidents reported to CARFAX and only about 3,800 miles on the odometer, this GLS 580 is about as close to a brand-new flagship as a pre-owned SUV gets. The history is laid out clearly above, so you can see exactly what you are getting. Mid Green paint, massaging seats and a twin-turbo V8 -- the carpool lane has never looked this good. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. ALPINE WHITE OVER TACORA RED SENSAFIN, 22-INCH M WHEELS, HIGHWAY ASSISTANT, RED M SPORT BRAKES AND HARMAN KARDON SURROUND SOUND.The sweeping coupe-inspired roofline and muscular stance make this X6 M60i unmistakable. Alpine White contrasts with a bold Tacora Red SensaFin interior, while the $1,800 22-inch M V-Spoke Jet Black Bi-Color wheels fill out its athletic profile. M Shadowline trim, M Shadowline Lights, red-caliper M Sport brakes and the M Sport exhaust system emphasize its performance character.BMW's 4.4-liter M TwinPower Turbo V8 produces 523 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque, complemented by 48-volt mild-hybrid technology. An 8-speed Sport Automatic Transmission with Launch Control sends power through xDrive all-wheel drive. The M Sport Differential, Adaptive M Suspension and Integral Active Steering give this performance luxury SUV sophisticated traction and handling. The EPA rates it at 17 MPG city and 22 MPG highway.The $2,500 Driving Assistance Professional Package brings Active Driving Assistant Pro and Highway Assistant, enabling hands-free driving assistance on compatible highways when conditions permit. The $900 Parking Assistance Package includes Parking Assistant Professional, Active Park Distance Control and 3D Surround View, with automated parking support and 360-degree camera visibility. Forward Collision Mitigation, Active Blind Spot Detection and Lane Keeping Assistant add everyday driver awareness.The $650 M Sport Professional Package sharpens its appearance with Extended Shadowline Trim, M Shadowline Lights and M Sport brakes with red calipers. The $1,000 Climate Comfort Package adds heated front and rear seating, heated front armrests and four-zone automatic climate control. Front ventilated multi-contour seats, a panoramic moonroof, Ambient Lighting and Fineline Black Wood trim combine comfort with a cockpit designed around the driver.BMW Curved Display with Live Cockpit Pro provides integrated navigation, digital instrumentation and Head-Up Display. Harman Kardon surround sound, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, wireless charging and ConnectedDrive services make this X6 as connected as it is quick. Comfort Access, Remote Engine Start and the Travel and Comfort System add daily convenience, while the $650 factory trailer hitch expands its usefulness for compatible towing equipment.Edmunds highlights the 2025 X6 M60i's powerful, smooth engine, high-quality interior and modern infotainment. The combination of V8 performance, athletic coupe styling and a well-equipped cabin distinguishes this BMW among luxury performance SUVs.Its factory options and accessories total $7,965 before destination, including the assistance, parking, climate and M Sport Professional packages, upgraded wheels, trailer hitch, rear side-window shades and floor mats. Original Total Suggested Retail Price was $103,440 including destination.CARFAX documents two previous owners and eight service history records. Maintenance includes replacement of all four tires and a four-wheel alignment in March 2026, followed by an oil and filter change in October 2026.Available at BMW of Tampa in Tampa Bay, this 2025 BMW X6 M60i xDrive has 25,058 miles.VIN: 5UX43EX03S9Y59446

The Winter Package and soft-close doors raise comfort further, joined by a power tilt/telescoping steering column, a 40/20/40 folding rear seat, hands-free access, a power liftgate, HomeLink and a 120V AC power outlet.

For technology, there are 2 front monitors, real-time traffic and a sound system with a 590-watt amplifier. The Driver Assistance Package works alongside Active Brake Assist with Autonomous Emergency Braking, PARKTRONIC with Advanced Parking Assist and the Aerial View Camera System. Driver Monitoring-Alert, a security system with video recording, a driver knee airbag, trailer sway control and a first aid kit are also included.

Recent Arrival! 2024 Land Rover Defender 110 V8 Black
Meet the 2024 Land Rover Defender 110 XV8, the most powerful and commanding Defender you can drive. Finished in Carpathian Grey over Ebony Windsor leather, this SUV pairs rugged, go-anywhere heritage with serious performance and a presence that turns heads everywhere it goes.

Under the hood, the 5.0 liter supercharged V8 delivers 525 horsepower through a smooth automatic transmission and permanent all-wheel drive. The result is effortless acceleration, confident highway passing, and a deep, authentic V8 soundtrack that makes every drive feel like an event. Even with that power on tap, the Defender stays composed and refined, with the legendary Land Rover capability to tackle trails, mud, snow, and rock when the pavement ends.

Step inside and you will find a cabin that blends durability with real comfort. The Ebony Windsor leather seats are supportive and beautifully finished, while the Ebony interior gives the cabin a cohesive, upscale feel. Twin front cupholders with a cover keep your drinks secure and the center console tidy, and the Basic Rear Seat Convenience Pack adds practical touches for second row passengers. Wi-Fi with a data plan keeps everyone connected, whether your are streaming on a road trip or working from a trailhead.

This Defender is built to take on the elements and the lifestyle that comes with them. The Premium Interior Protection and Storage Pack helps guard the cabin against mud, spills, and daily wear, while keeping your gear organized and within reach. The Integrated Air Compressor is a game changer for off-road adventures, letting you air down for traction on the trail and air back up before heading home, or top off a tire anywhere you find yourself.

Outside, the 22" Style 5098 wheels in Gloss Black and the Extended Black Exterior Pack give this Defender a bold, aggressive stance that stands apart from the crowd. The Body-colored Spare Wheel Cover ties the rear of the vehicle together with a clean, factory-finished look, and the Black Wheel Protection Pack helps defend those stylish wheels from curb rash and trail scuffs. The Emergency Pack adds extra peace of mind on longer journeys and remote routes.

The Defender 110 XV8 blends iconic design, true off-road engineering, and supercar-rivaling power in one unforgettable package. It is equally at home on a city street, a mountain pass, or a back-country trail, ready for whatever your next adventure holds.

Don't miss your chance to own this exceptional 2024 Land Rover Defender 110 XV8. Schedule your test drive today and experience the difference for yourself.

Originally stickered at $133,850, this dynamic, athletic and impeccably finished 2024 Range Rover Sport Autobiography brings together bold design and true luxury in one of the most sought-after combinations you will find. Presented in Santorini Black with a rich SV Bespoke Garnet interior, it makes a statement the moment you see it and keeps impressing long after you step inside.

STRIKING FROM EVERY ANGLE
Santorini Black is a deep, mirror-like finish that gives the Range Rover Sports sculpted, muscular lines a powerful and sophisticated presence. The Black Exterior Package carries that theme through with darkened exterior accents, creating a confident, monochromatic look that stands out in any parking lot. Deployable Side Steps extend automatically when you open the door and tuck neatly out of sight when you close it, making entry and exit effortless while preserving the clean, uninterrupted profile.

A CABIN OF REAL DISTINCTION
Inside, SV Bespoke Garnet semi-aniline leather seating sets this Autobiography apart from the usual choices. Soft, supple and naturally textured, the rich garnet hides contrast beautifully with the dark exterior and give the cabin a warm, tailored feel. The Meridian seats add another layer of indulgence, wrapping you in comfort on the daily commute or a cross-country road trip. Every surface is thoughtfully crafted, so the interior feels less like a vehicle and more like a private lounge.

QUIET, SECURE AND REFINED
Laminated front and rear side glass helps hush road and wind noise for a calmer, more serene ride, while adding an extra measure of security and peace of mind. It is the kind of thoughtful detail that you may not notice at first, but you will appreciate on every drive, whether you are carrying family, clients or a weekends worth of luggage in complete comfort. Quiet is a hallmark of true luxury, and this Range Rover Sport delivers it.

THE AUTOBIOGRAPHY DIFFERENCE
